What Cloudflare's interstitial actually sends

A challenge page loads /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/h/b/orchestrate/chl_page/v1 and sets a __cf_chl_ cookie before redirecting you back.

Detecting it

if (html.includes("cf-browser-verification")) { /* naive: matches this very page */ }
if (html.includes("cf_chl_opt")) { /* also naive */ }

Matching on those strings anywhere in the document flags articles like this one.
